mapper.insert: insert into biz_survey_answer (survey_id, submit_ip, submit_ua, submit_time, cost_ms, channel_code, client_token, valid_flag, remark) values (#{surveyId}, #{submitIp}, #{submitUa}, now(), #{costMs}, #{channelCode}, #{clientToken}, coalesce(#{validFlag}, '1'), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId}
select count(1) from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId} and coalesce(valid_flag, '1') <> '0'
select count(1) from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId} and submit_ip = #{submitIp}
select count(1) from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId} and client_token = #{clientToken}

select coalesce(nullif(trim(channel_code), ''), '(默认)') as "channelCode", count(1) as "count" from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId} and coalesce(valid_flag, '1') <> '0' group by coalesce(nullif(trim(channel_code), ''), '(默认)') order by count(1) desc

select to_char(submit_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", count(1) as "count" from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId} and coalesce(valid_flag, '1') <> '0' and submit_time is not null group by to_char(submit_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by to_char(submit_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') asc
